items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: So we used to get together at the house and play.

ctx.x: But this kid, Oswald Gibson, was still there in high school. He was at Armstrong High School, the same high school that I had gone to. As a matter of fact, he was in high school with my brother, who was younger than I. And they had a band down there, and these kids in the band... A fellow named professor had the band. And these kids in the band, a couple of them were trying to learn and had been listening to Jazz and musicians and whatever. This fellow Oswald Gibson... There was another saxophone player, Wash we…

One of the fellows that used to come by the same club where I used to meet all of these musicians was a fellow whose name was Billy Roberts. He played the guitar. Billy Roberts was a grown man, and... Somehow he got the idea in his head that he would like to have a band of youngsters. By knowing me... I don't know whether he had heard of Oswald Gibson or
